product.name: TransLand
product.longName: Sistem Perlindungan dan Integrasi Data Tanah Transmigrasi Berbasis Risiko
product.tagline: Identifikasi dini. Status terlacak. Risiko ditindaklanjuti.
product.coreQuestion: Bagaimana negara memastikan setiap bidang tanah transmigrasi dapat diidentifikasi, dilacak statusnya, dan dilindungi sebelum kehilangan kepastian hukum?
product.problemStatement: Masalah tanah transmigrasi bukan semata-mata karena tanah tersebut belum bersertifikat, tetapi karena negara belum memiliki mekanisme terintegrasi untuk mengetahui bidang mana yang paling rentan, mengapa rentan, dan tindakan apa yang harus diprioritaskan.
product.architecture: federated land-risk registry and case orchestration layer
beneficiaries: Instansi pemerintah yang memerlukan kepastian status objek
Pelaku usaha yang memerlukan spatial clearance sebelum keputusan

does: memberi ID stabil pada objek/bidang tanah transmigrasi dalam prototype
menghubungkan status tanah, kawasan, tata ruang, konsesi/izin, BMN, administrasi wilayah, dan status layanan dari sumber berbeda
mendeteksi mismatch, overlap, status kedaluwarsa, dan evidence gap
mengurutkan prioritas berdasarkan risiko dan kedekatan milestone layanan
membuat case dengan reason, owner, next action, target review, dan audit trail
mendukung pre-clearance sebelum izin/kebijakan berbasis lokasi
doesNot: mengubah status kawasan hutan atau tata ruang
menggantikan sistem ATR/BPN, SIPUKAT, OSS, ESDM, KLHK, DJKN, atau Kemendagri
menganggap overlap geometrik sebagai bukti hukum final

meta.prototypePilot: Parit Rambutan, Ogan Ilir, Sumatera Selatan
meta.dataPolicy: Setiap status harus mempunyai sumber, tanggal/vintage, otoritas, dan evidence class. Konflik antarsumber ditampilkan, bukan ditimpa.
meta.privacyPolicy: Prototype lomba tidak memuat nama/NIK/alamat real atau koordinat bidang sensitif riil.
meta.dailyUseLogic: Aplikasi aktif terus-menerus melalui event-driven risk monitoring, bukan hanya ketika ada pemekaran wilayah.

rules: Every factual numeric datum must have source_ids and vintage/reference year when known.
Keep raw source labels and normalized candidates separately; never silently correct source text.
Do not compare metrics with different methods/vintages as if they were identical.
Null means unavailable or not verified; zero is a valid observed value only when explicitly sourced.
Scenario records must display a visible SIMULASI badge and may not be cited as real-world outcomes.
Spatial overlay is a screening signal; unresolved or legally sensitive cases require human verification.
Legal and administrative decisions remain with authorized institutions.
No household PII may be stored in the competition prototype.
provenancePolicy.conflictHandling: Preserve both observations, show source/vintage/method, and create a data-quality flag instead of overwriting.

pilot.name: Parit Rambutan

fieldEvidence.finding: Land history can include replacement documents, boundary shifts, and changes in physical control/markers.
Important documents are available but distributed across local-government offices, village offices and land institutions without a unified integrated system in the field-study context.
Field team used by-name-by-parcel reconciliation linking identity, tenure history and coordinates with old maps, current land data and aerial imagery, then validated with residents.
Ogan Ilir local government coordinated with BPN South Sumatra in April 2026 to accelerate long-awaited SHM resolution for SP2 Parit Rambutan.

pilot.metricGuardrail: IPKT and INTRANS observations have different metric/vintage contexts. Display side-by-side only with explicit labels; never calculate a difference as improvement/deterioration without method reconciliation.

Sensitive/controlled; competition MVP uses synthetic data only

allowed: Official June 2026 village-boundary metadata records unresolved/misaligned conditions, including some split villages lacking geometry/codes.
Kementrans performance reporting identifies untimely regional data delivery and limited HR as contributors to slow information exchange.
Permentrans 9/2025 explicitly connects transmigration planning to administrative boundaries and village names/codes.
SIPUKAT already provides a national spatial-information platform; SINTAS is therefore designed as a continuity/change-impact layer, not a replacement map.
Parit Rambutan is a real current pilot context with 16 villages and unresolved land-service context documented by official sources.
conditional: Boundary changes can create service-continuity risk — treat as a mechanism/hypothesis to validate with real cases, not a universal causal fact.
SINTAS can improve routing/detection — claim only after task-based evaluation.
Reference-date crosswalk can support BPS/Kementrans statistics — it does not replace official statistical production.
prohibited: Indonesia has no transmigration data or map.
A polygon overlap proves a household legally belongs to a village.
SINTAS issues SHM or decides land ownership.
Scenario households or boundary events are real Parit Rambutan cases.
IPKT 2023 and INTRANS 2025 are directly comparable measures without methodological reconciliation.
SINTAS is proven to reduce national service time before empirical evaluation.

bands.label: Rendah
bands.meaning: Tidak ada konflik signifikan yang terdeteksi dari data terhubung; tetap bukan opini hukum.

bands.label: Prioritas
bands.meaning: Ada overlap, service risk, atau cross-authority issue yang memerlukan tindak lanjut terarah.

bands.label: Kritis
bands.meaning: Risiko tinggi + layanan/keputusan aktif; perlu eskalasi manusia segera.

allowed: Land-transmigration problems include unresolved certification and documented overlap with forest-area and other land-control regimes.
TransLand prioritizes risk review by connecting statuses from multiple regimes to one stable object.
The prototype can be evaluated on detection, routing, evidence recognition and workflow performance.
conditional: A single source of truth means a federated cross-regime registry, not one ministry owning all truth.
Risk scoring is only a prioritization aid; weights require expert validation.
Pre-clearance can reduce late conflict detection only after empirical pilot evaluation.
prohibited: All transmigration land conflicts are caused by poor data integration.
Every spatial overlap is an illegal conflict.
A green status is legal approval.
Synthetic demo events/objects are real Parit Rambutan cases.
